title: 早春賦 (Sōshunfu — Ode to Early Spring)
description: A beloved Taisho-era art song lamenting that though spring has been announced by name, the wind remains bitterly cold and the uguisu (bush warbler) refuses to sing — it is not yet truly spring's time. One of Japan's most cherished seasonal songs, often sung at school graduation ceremonies. The title is a classical literary term meaning 'ode to early spring.'
